title: Agent platform benchmark: what public docs say
disclaimer: Scores measure vendor-published documentation, not product capability. not_found means unknown, not absent. Every score is a range (worst and best case); the public evidence does not support ranking these platforms. Nothing was tested hands-on.

dimensions.label: Evaluation and quality assurance
dimensions.question: Can a buyer measure the agent's quality before and after go-live with the vendor's own tooling?

dimensions.label: Production and governance readiness
dimensions.question: Can the agent be integrated, escalated, secured and contracted under jurisdiction-neutral enterprise controls?

dimensions.label: Voice, channels and European fit
dimensions.question: Can the agent reach European customers on the channels and languages they use, under EU-specific data and AI rules?

criteria.label: At least 5 other EU official languages listed
